optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Fraud Analytics Analyst, Card Fraud Detection

professionalSummary.text: Fraud analytics analyst with three years of experience in a card issuer's fraud detection team, analyzing flagged-transaction outcomes and proposing rule threshold changes with expected alert volumes for approval by the fraud strategy manager.
professionalSummary.witness: Fraud analytics analyst in a card issuer's fraud detection team for three years, analysing flagged-transaction outcomes each week and proposing rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes; the changes were approved by the fraud strategy manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly fraud performance packs for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates, and the effect of monthly rule changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of the month's rule changes.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored fraud model alert precision weekly and raised two drift cases to model owners, both documented in the model monitoring log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on the weekly monitoring dashboard and raised two drift cases to the model owners, both recorded in the model monitoring log.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated rule changes with the fraud operations desk via change notes, explicitly documenting responsibility boundaries between the analyst and desk supervisor.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated each rule change with the fraud operations desk through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which belonged to the desk supervisor.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented rule change limitations and hand-over conditions in each rule change note for the fraud operations desk.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section of each rule change note and the hand-over conditions for the desk.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided work samples including a rule change proposal with expected alert volumes and approval record, monthly fraud performance pack, and model monitoring log extract for two drift cases, with fraud tool references as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one rule change proposal with its expected alert volumes and approval record, one monthly fraud performance pack and the model monitoring log extract for the two drift cases, with the fraud tool references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Fraud model monitoring, rule change coordination, performance pack preparation, and documentation of rule change boundaries.
skills.witness: Fraud analytics analyst in a card issuer's fraud detection team for three years, analysing flagged-transaction outcomes each week and proposing rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes; the changes were approved by the fraud strategy manager. Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of the month's rule changes. Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on the weekly monitoring dashboard and raised two drift cases to the model owners, both recorded in the model monitoring log. Coordinated each rule change with the fraud operations desk through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which belonged to the desk supervisor. Wrote the limitation section of each rule change note and the hand-over conditions for the desk.

Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of the month's rule changes.
Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on the weekly monitoring dashboard and raised two drift cases to the model owners, both recorded in the model monitoring log.
Coordinated each rule change with the fraud operations desk through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which belonged to the desk supervisor.
Wrote the limitation section of each rule change note and the hand-over conditions for the desk.
